import hashlib,platform,shutil,subprocess,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
if platform.machine()!='x86_64': raise RuntimeError('Needs setup: this PHP recipe requires Linux x86_64')
with urllib.request.urlopen('https://arch.mirror.constant.com/extra/os/x86_64/php-8.5.10-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst',timeout=30) as response: data=response.read(8*1024*1024)
if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()!='0354a6573db83afa3918d2e1555f3a2d9914a66e43cab00e00e449070f973dd2': raise RuntimeError('PHP checksum mismatch')
Path('/runtime/php.pkg.tar.zst').write_bytes(data)
Path('/runtime/php').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run(['tar','--zstd','-xf','/runtime/php.pkg.tar.zst','-C','/runtime/php','usr/bin/php','usr/lib/php/modules/curl.so'],check=True)
shutil.copytree('/package/api','/runtime/api',dirs_exist_ok=True)
shutil.copy2('/package/router.php','/runtime/router.php')
helper=Path('/runtime/api/helper.php')
text=helper.read_text()
if 'CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false' not in text: raise RuntimeError('Upstream TLS code changed')
helper.write_text(text.replace('CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, false','CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true'))

import json,urllib.request
config=json.load(open('/run/pandamonium/config.json'))
with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:'+config['PANDAMONIUM_PORT']+'/recent',timeout=20) as response: data=json.load(response)
sounds=data['data'][:10]
if not sounds: raise RuntimeError('No sound records returned; upstream availability needs checking')
print(json.dumps({'sounds':sounds}))
